title: Young co-pilot, 20, named as one of nine victims of deadly Florida plane crash
description:
Nathalia Filgueiras was onboard private plane bound for Bahamas that crashed in Palm Beach county

Family members on Monday identified a young Florida pilot as one of nine victims of a plane crash in Palm Beach county that occurred during a heavy thunderstorm.

Nathalia Filgueiras, 20, was co-pilot of the private Learjet 60 that was en route from Austin-Bergstrom international airport in Texas to North Eleuthera airport in the Bahamas on Sunday when it suddenly plummeted out of the sky, her mother told the New York Times.
